channels.name: City of Tampa: Objects on streets, alleys, sidewalks (right-of-way)
channels.submission_instructions: Submit through Tampa Connect with the street name plus the two nearest cross streets or the nearest address, and attach this report. For emergency clean-up do NOT use the online form: call (813) 274-3101, answered 24 hours a day.

channels.name: City of Tampa Customer Service Center (Tampa Connect)
channels.submission_instructions: General City of Tampa service requests. Pick the closest request type and attach this report. Downed power lines from fallen trees are an emergency: call TECO at (813) 228-1111 instead.

channels.name: Tampa Electric (TECO) emergency line: downed power lines
channels.submission_instructions: Call for electrical emergencies such as power lines brought down by fallen trees. Stay away from the lines.
